summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass due to class III morbid obesity with a BMI of 40. She also had comorbid obstructive sleep apnea, gastroesophageal reflux, polycystic ovary syndrome, and fatty liver disease. The surgery was performed successfully, and she tolerated the procedure well. Postoperatively, an upper GI study confirmed no anastomotic leak, and her diet was advanced from clear liquids to stage three over the hospital stay. Pain was controlled with oral Roxicet, and she remained ambulatory. She was discharged home with instructions to continue crushed medications, follow a stage three diet, avoid straws and heavy lifting, and monitor for signs of complications. Follow-up was scheduled in two weeks.
